headline: Estonia October Inflation Climbs to 11-Month High of 4.2%
summary: Estonia's consumer price inflation accelerated further in October to 4.2%, reaching its highest level in nearly a year compared to 3.5% in September.
why: Consumer price indices reflect inflationary pressures within eurozone economies, guiding European Central Bank policy evaluations.

impacts.name: Estonia
impacts.why: Accelerating inflation indicates rising cost-of-living pressures within the domestic economy.
